3. Box Model Diagram Explanation

The CSS Box Model ek structure define karta hai jo har HTML element ke around
hoti hai. Ismein 4 main parts hote hain:

   1. Content – Jahaan text ya images hote hain
   2. Padding – Content aur border ke darmiyan ka space
   3. Border – Element ka edge jo padding ke baad aata hai
   4. Margin – Border aur doosray elements ke darmiyan ka space
